abort.already_configured: Church Drive is already set up.

scenes.title: Universal scenes
scenes.description: Choose the Hue rooms and zones that get the universal scenes. Scenes are created on the Hue bridge; a room's existing Hue scene with the same name is left as it is and used instead.

health.title: Device health
health.description: Choose the devices to watch. Church Drive spots ones whose state has gone stale (old readings after a restart, stopped updating, unavailable for over 5 minutes) and fixes them automatically: it refreshes them and re-sends their last real state (fans and thermostats). If a fan still doesn't respond, it nudges it (a few seconds in another mode, then back) after 1.5, 10 and 30 minutes. It never reloads an integration on its own.

maps.title: Google maps
maps.description: Keys from Google Cloud (APIs & Services › Credentials). With a Map Tiles key, maps across Home Assistant use Google's satellite (with shop and road names) or road map; lock that key to Home Assistant's web addresses, as browsers use it. With a Places key, the zone map's search finds shops and businesses; Home Assistant does the searching, so that key never reaches a browser. Leave either blank to use the free Esri maps and OpenStreetMap search.

abort.hue_not_ready: The Hue integration isn't connected to the bridge yet. Try again in a moment.

sync_scenes.name: Sync universal scenes
sync_scenes.description: Create or update the universal scenes on the Hue bridge for the chosen rooms and zones.

apply_scene.name: Apply universal scene
apply_scene.description: Set lights, rooms or zones to a universal scene (e.g. Bright), without a Hue scene.

entity_id.name: Lights
entity_id.description: Lights, rooms or zones to set.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Scene name, e.g. Bright or Relax.

health_fix.name: Fix a device
health_fix.description: Refresh, re-sync (send its last real state), nudge (a brief real change, then back) or reconnect (reload its integration) a watched device.

notify.name: Notify people
notify.description: Send a notification to the people assigned to a kind in Manager, on each of their phones.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Which kind of notification (as set in Manager), e.g. doorbell. It goes to the people ticked for it. Leave empty to send to the people named below.

people.name: People
people.description: Only these people (first names or person entities). With a kind: only those of them ticked for it.

admin_message.name: Admin-only line
admin_message.description: An extra line only administrators see (e.g. a cost).

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: A new notification with the same tag replaces the old one.

link.name: Opens
link.description: The page a tap opens, e.g. /dashboard-mobile/security.

image.name: Picture
image.description: A picture to show, e.g. a camera snapshot URL.

critical.name: Sound on silent
critical.description: Sound even when the phone is on silent. Defaults to the kind's setting (on for safety alarms).

data.name: Extra data
data.description: Anything else for the companion app's notification data.

task_list.name: Task's list
task_list.description: With the task's id, adds Done and Snooze buttons (for a reminder about a to-do task sent to one person).

task_uid.name: Task's id
task_uid.description: The to-do item's uid, from todo.get_items.

add_tasks.name: Add tasks from text
add_tasks.description: Read a message or note with AI, split it into tasks and put each on the right to-do list. By default the tasks wait in the inbox to be checked; Auto add puts them straight on the lists.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who it's for or from; their own list is used when the text doesn't say.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where it came from, e.g. WhatsApp or Voice.

auto_add.name: Auto add
auto_add.description: Skip the check and add the tasks now.

ai_task_entity.name: AI Task
ai_task_entity.description: Which AI Task entity reads it (the first one by default).
